notes: The spinning cloud on the media card now drifts through colour as it turns. It starts on your chosen gold, travels out through the spectrum and comes back the same way, taking about a minute for the round trip.
It uses the same colour dial the Loader Studio slider writes, so this is the existing control being given a journey rather than a second colour system.
The colour holds still while paused, along with the rotation. A paused card that carried on changing colour would not really be paused.
